title: No Nether Water Bucket
description: When going to the nether, any water bucket within your immidiate inventory will evaporate.
body:
# No Nether Water Buckets



Ever thought it was odd how any water in the nether evaporates, but you can carry water buckets in there without any issues?

If you'd like the water to evaporate before you try placing it, this **DATA PACK** aims to do just that.

## How it works:

When in the nether, any water bucket in or entering your inventory will evaporate.

**This includes water buckets with animals in them:**
- Cod and Salmon will boil into Cooked Cod and Salmon.
- Pufferfish and Tropical Fish will also drop in item form.
- Tadpoles and Axolotls will spawn their entity versions.
